notes: Starting cards as posted under Start (8): Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die, Battle Order, Combat Response, Mobilization Points, Prepared Defenses, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon; these count. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'Court' dested Court Of The Vile Gangster; 'JP AC' and 'JP Dungeon' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark) and Jabba's Palace: Dungeon; 'Tat Great pit' dested Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon (Court's starting site).
Posted 'Ig-88 In boat', 'Zuckuss In Boat', 'Bossk in boat' and 'Dengar in boat' dested IG-88 In IG-2000, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Bossk In Hound's Tooth and Dengar In Punishing One.
Posted 'Darth with flashlight' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Mara Jade, hot chick' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Emperor Palpy' dested Emperor Palpatine.

Posted 'I have you “later”' dested I Have You Now (a play on the card name); 'Drak Jedi Presence' dested Dark Jedi Presence; 'You can't hide forever' dested You Cannot Hide Forever; 'Reactor termal' dested Reactor Terminal.

Posted 'Spaceprt DB' dested Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark) (the strategy plays 'the Spaceport docking bay'); 'D2DB', 'Coruscant DB' and 'Executor DB' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay, Coruscant: Docking Bay and Executor: Docking Bay; Rendili is the Dark Special Edition system.
